items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; block new public exposure and security-sensitive releases pending evidence. Evidence: security fleet-doctor has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; 61 managed sites have unknown legal-family security metadata; TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown, but is a technical baseline rather than certification. Exact decision: preserve existing private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Do not clear any security-sensitive release or new public exposure. Continue one consolidated read-only evidence matrix from authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.
